item.title: People used an AI adviser’s track record when they could check its answers.
item.description: AI source-checked summary (not human review; arxiv_preprint_v1). Original summary checked against the stated source by a separate AI pass; not human review or independent replication. Limited reading. Preprint, not verified peer-reviewed evidence. Article screening is not peer review; reported results do not establish strong causal evidence. Source version: arxiv_preprint_v1.: People used an AI adviser’s track record when they could check its answers. Without a way to verify earlier answers, an apparently helpful conversation could still lead someone away from an initially correct judgment.

item.title: Hard math felt more difficult with an AI tutor than with a human tutor on the second set of problems.
item.description: AI source-checked summary (not human review; publisher_version_of_record): Hard math felt more difficult with an AI tutor than with a human tutor on the second set of problems. Students worked through two sets of unfamiliar math problems. The experiment asked how they responded when the work got hard and which difficulty levels they chose afterward.
